ffmpeg_contract.behavior: set_vbr enables maxQP only when both AVCodecContext.qmin and qmax are nonnegative. Both bounds also derive initial QP unless explicitly supplied.162 control disables both bounds; trials use qmin0/qmax32 or28, all with identical explicit initial P/I/B QP26. VBR and VBV retained.

decision: Multipass and tune changes are rejected. Active QP32 improves worst first-cut SSIM0.88505 to0.90193 with897.192 to905.386kbit/s; QP28 reaches0.93619 but1030.519kbit/s. Test only QP32 in the actual cropped H264 NVENC path before retaining a product change. No hardware throughput or acceptance claim from offline encode speed.
